prompt: Four scatterplots have correlation coefficients $r = 0.85$, $r = -0.92$, $r = 0.15$ and $r = -0.40$. Which one shows the STRONGEST linear relationship?
hint: Strength is about how CLOSE $r$ is to $1$ or $-1$. The sign only tells the direction.

hints.text: Strength is about how CLOSE $r$ is to $1$ or $-1$. The sign only tells the direction.
$|{-0.92}| = 0.92$ is the largest, so $r = -0.92$ is the strongest: choice B.

explanation: The correlation $r$ runs from $-1$ to $1$; values near either end mean the points hug a line tightly.
$0.92$ is the biggest, so $r = -0.92$ describes the tightest (strongest) linear pattern. Choice B.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture each plot
steps: $r = 0.15$: a shapeless blob. $r = -0.40$: a loose downhill cloud.
$r = 0.85$: a fairly tight uphill band. $r = -0.92$: an even tighter downhill band.
Tightest band wins, regardless of up or down.
